files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, clean membership by trimming spaces and lower-casing, then give each rider three indicator columns is_annual, is_casual and is_monthly holding 1 for the rider's level and 0 otherwise. `result` should be a table with columns rider_id (text, leading zeros kept), is_annual, is_casual, is_monthly, one row per rider in the file's order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv keeping rider_id as text; clean membership (strip, lower case); one row per rider in file order with columns rider_id, is_annual, is_casual, is_monthly, each indicator 1 for the rider's level and 0 otherwise.

acceptable_variants.notes: indicators may be booleans; extra columns are not expected
